description: A gray plastic bin with ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup nearby and a purple scoop off to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and slides it into the bin to gather ice, while the left hand steadies the bin, then the right hand lifts the scoop and moves it over as the left hand raises and holds the yellow cup; the right hand tips the scoop to dump the ice into the cup and then pulls the scoop away.
